edits.text: PARTIES. This Executive Employment Agreement (this “Agreement”) is entered into by and between Vireo Systems Inc., a corporation organized under applicable law (the “Company”), and the individual identified on the signature page hereto (the “Executive”).
edits.name: Revise Parties clause

edits.text: 1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer and shall perform such duties and responsibilities as are customarily associated with that position and as may reasonably be assigned by the Company’s Chief Executive Officer or Board of Directors. The Executive shall devote substantially all working time, attention, and skill to the business and affairs of the Company.
edits.name: Revise Position clause

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary in the amount set forth on Exhibit A (the “Base Salary”), payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholdings and deductions. The Executive shall also be eligible to participate in benefit plans and programs generally made available to similarly situated senior executives, subject to the terms of such plans and programs.
edits.name: Revise Compensation clause

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, subject to the Executive’s execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims in favor of the Company, the Executive shall receive the severance benefits set forth on Exhibit A (the “Severance Amount”), payable in accordance with the schedule set forth therein and subject to applicable withholdings and deductions.
edits.name: Revise Severance clause

edits.text: 4. NON-COMPETE. During the Executive’s employment and for twelve (12) months following the termination of employment for any reason, the Executive shall not, directly or indirectly, engage in competitive activities with any business that competes with the Company, within the geographic area in which the Company conducts material business, to the extent permitted by applicable law. The parties agree that this restriction shall be construed and enforced only to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law.
edits.name: Revise Non-Compete clause

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. Attached is our revised draft. We have populated Exhibit A conceptually with the agreed compensation framework, added target annual bonus/equity eligibility language consistent with the COO role, revised severance to 12 months of Base Salary plus COBRA premium reimbursement payable in installments following the release effective date, and narrowed the non-compete to apply only following a termination for Cause or voluntary resignation without Good Reason, limited to businesses/products with which the Executive had material involvement during the prior 12 months and subject to applicable law.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary in the amount set forth on Exhibit A (the “Base Salary”), payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholdings and deductions. The Executive shall also be eligible to participate in benefit plans and programs generally made available to similarly situated senior executives, subject to the terms of such plans and programs. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in the Company’s annual bonus and equity incentive programs at a level consistent with the Executive’s position as Chief Operating Officer, in each case as set forth on Exhibit A and subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plan documents and award agreements.
edits.name: Compensation revised to add COO-level bonus/equity eligibility

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, subject to the Executive’s execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims in favor of the Company within the time period specified by the Company, the Executive shall receive the severance benefits set forth on Exhibit A (the “Severance Amount”), payable in substantially equal installments over the severance period specified on Exhibit A in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices, commencing on the first administratively practicable payroll date following the effective date of the release, and subject to applicable withholdings and deductions. Any COBRA premium reimbursement described on Exhibit A shall be subject to the Executive’s timely election of COBRA continuation coverage and continued eligibility for such coverage.
edits.name: Severance revised for installments and COBRA mechanics

edits.text: 4. NON-COMPETE. During the Executive’s employment and, solely following a termination of the Executive’s employment by the Company for Cause or a voluntary resignation by the Executive without Good Reason, for twelve (12) months following such termination, the Executive shall not, directly or indirectly, engage in competitive activities with respect to any business, product, or service with which the Executive had material involvement during the twelve (12) months preceding the termination date, within the geographic area in which the Company conducts material business, to the extent permitted by applicable law. The parties agree that this restriction shall be construed and enforced only to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, and shall not apply to the extent prohibited or restricted by applicable state law.
edits.name: Non-compete narrowed to Cause/resignation without Good Reason, material involvement, and state law limits

edits.text:
EXHIBIT A

Compensation and Severance Terms

1. Base Salary. The Executive’s annual Base Salary shall be $[●], subject to periodic review and adjustment by the Company.

2. Annual Bonus. The Executive shall be eligible for an annual target bonus opportunity consistent with the Executive’s position as Chief Operating Officer, as determined by the Company and subject to achievement of applicable performance goals and the terms of the Company’s annual bonus program.

3. Equity Eligibility. The Executive shall be eligible to receive equity or equity-based awards at a level consistent with the Executive’s position as Chief Operating Officer, as determined by the Company and subject to approval by the Board of Directors or applicable committee and the terms of the Company’s equity incentive plan and applicable award agreements.

4. Severance. Subject to the requirements of Section 3 of the Agreement, the Severance Amount shall consist of: (a) continued payment of twelve (12) months of the Executive’s Base Salary, payable in substantially equal installments in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices following the effective date of the release; and (b) if the Executive timely elects COBRA continuation coverage, reimbursement of the employer portion of COBRA premiums for up to twelve (12) months following the termination date, or if earlier, until the Executive becomes eligible for substantially comparable group health coverage through another employer.
edits.name: Add populated Exhibit A framework
